extends Node
export(Resource) var thing # A_Thing

func _ready() -> void:
	print('first frame')
	print(is_instance_valid(thing))
	print(thing.g1())
	print(thing.g2())
	print(thing.g3())
	yield(get_tree(), 'idle_frame')

	print('second frame')
	thing.s1(0)
	thing.s2(0)
	thing.s3('0')
	print(thing.g1())
	print(thing.g2())
	print(thing.g2())
	yield(get_tree(), 'idle_frame')

	print('third frame')
	if get_global('stop'):
		breakpoint
		return
	set_global('stop', true)
	get_tree().root.add_child(Node.new())
	get_tree().change_scene(get_tree().current_scene.filename)

func set_global(n, v): get_tree().set_meta(n, v)
func get_global(s): if get_tree().has_meta(s): return get_tree().get_meta(s)
